verdict.rationale: RUN documents a built-in AI-powered virtual assistant, but it is described only as answering payroll and HR questions, not as carrying out tasks on the user's behalf. Adjacent AI features (timesheet import, error flagging) are automations rather than a delegable assistant, so they add little. missing for 10: evidence the assistant can execute or complete tasks (e.g., run payroll, update records) on request, depth of assistant documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration
